summary: Revised implementation plan combining the App Performance & Lag Optimization audit with the Status Bar Visibility, Overlapping Content, and System Insets architecture. Addresses status bar disappearance, icon contrast (forcing light icons via SystemBarStyle.dark and WindowInsetsController), solid DarkSurface status bar scrims, unconstrained screen insets, as well as Room N+1 query elimination, @Immutable recomposition skipping, Coil thumbnail downsampling, and release APK shrinking.
